ticket:
PAY-4420 [Bug] Total refunds exceed the payment amount

Merchant m_8812 refunded 600.00 twice on a 1000.00 USD payment through
POST /payments/{id}/refunds. Both calls returned 201, the payment shows
"refunded_amount": "1200.00" and "remaining_amount": "-200.00", and its status is
still SUCCEEDED. Finance had to recover 200.00 manually.

Expected: the sum of all refunds of a payment can never exceed the payment amount. A
refund larger than what is left must be rejected with 422 refund_exceeds_remaining and
must not change the payment. Refunding exactly the remaining amount is allowed and moves
the payment to REFUNDED.

   15		switch {

   18		case errors.Is(err, payment.ErrInvalidTransition):
   19			status, code = http.StatusConflict, "invalid_transition"
   20		case errors.Is(err, payment.ErrVersionConflict):
   21			status, code = http.StatusConflict, "conflict"
   22		case errors.Is(err, payment.ErrRefundExceedsRemaining):
   23			status, code = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "refund_exceeds_remaining"
   24		case errors.Is(err, payment.ErrInvalidInput),
   25			errors.Is(err, payment.ErrInvalidCursor),
   26			errors.Is(err, money.ErrInvalidAmount),
   27			errors.Is(err, money.ErrPrecision),
   28			errors.Is(err, money.ErrUnknownCurrency),

   35		}

args.summary: Fixed the over-refund bug in payment/service.go. Refund compared the requested amount to the full payment amount instead of what was left. It now compares against Amount - Refunded. An oversized refund returns ErrRefundExceedsRemaining, which the API maps to 422 refund_exceeds_remaining, and the payment isn't changed. A refund of exactly the remaining amount is still allowed and moves the payment to REFUNDED. I added a regression test (600 then 600 on 1000 is rejected, then 400 succeeds and the status becomes REFUNDED). The full suite passes with -race, and gofmt reports nothing.
